setup: You are writing a number of parts of a unit as a fraction of the whole unit.

steps.say: The unit has \([[total]]\) parts in all, so the fraction is the parts taken over that total.
Reducing gives \(\frac{[[out_num]]}{[[out_den]]}\). Reducing matters for units whose part count is not a power of ten, such as an hour or a day.

answer: So the fraction of the unit is \(\frac{[[out_num]]}{[[out_den]]}\).
